yd:
Claude Code remote control lets you drive all of your Claude Code sessions from your phone, but it is not on by default. Ask Claude Code to turn it on by default and every new session you start shows up on your phone automatically. No more forgetting to switch it on. Keep working from your phone wherever you are.
